# RECORD OF ADVICE: POLICY AMENDMENT
**Policy Number:** POL-2024-882  
**Amendment Type:** Addition of Motor Vehicle  
**Date of Advice:** [INSERT DATE]

---

## 3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Vehicle – 2023 Toyota Corolla (Value R320,000)**

• New vehicle acquisition requires comprehensive motor insurance cover
• Vehicle is modern, financed or owned outright – necessitates full theft and accidental damage protection
• Standard commuting use (personal/domestic) identified during telephone confirmation
• Driver age and claims history reviewed against existing policy records
• Replacement value R320,000 requires adequate sum insured to avoid underinsurance penalties
• Third-party liability exposure on public roads creates statutory legal obligation under Road Traffic Act
• New vehicle qualifies for manufacturer's warranty – gap cover may be applicable depending on financing structure
• No material change to household risk profile; addition is supplementary to existing dwelling and contents cover
• Client's existing claims history (zero claims noted) supports standard underwriting terms

---

## 4. MARKET COMPARISON

**Insurer A: Momentum Short-Term Insurance**

Premium quoted: R185 per month (R2,220 annually) | Excess: R7,500 (standard); R10,000 (optional reduction) | Key inclusions: Accidental damage, theft, third-party liability, roadside assistance, 24-hour claims support | Assessment: Competitive premium positioning; excess structure acceptable for vehicle value; strong claims reputation in motor segment

**Insurer B: Santam**

Premium quoted: R198 per month (R2,376 annually) | Excess: R5,000 (standard); R7,500 (optional increase for lower premium) | Key inclusions: Accidental damage, theft, third-party liability, windscreen cover, rental vehicle benefit | Assessment: Premium 7% higher than Insurer A; more favorable excess structure; rental benefit adds value; marginally broader cover scope

**Insurer C: Old Mutual Insure**

Premium quoted: R172 per month (R2,064 annually) | Excess: R8,500 (standard); higher deductible options available | Key inclusions: Accidental damage, theft, third-party liability, basic roadside assistance (limited to towing) | Assessment: Lowest premium (7% below Insurer A); higher excess creates additional out-of-pocket liability; minimal value-adds; roadside assistance limited in scope

**Recommendation Rationale: Santam Selected**

• Premium differential of R156 annually vs. Insurer A justified by superior excess terms (R5,000 vs. R7,500)
• Windscreen cover inclusion protects against common high-frequency claims on modern vehicles
• Rental vehicle benefit addresses transport continuity during claim settlement – material benefit for client with existing motor cover
• Claims handling reputation consistent with client's zero-claims profile and expectation of efficient service
• Excess structure provides balance between affordability and acceptable out-of-pocket cost in event of claim
• Product aligns with existing Santam relationship (if applicable to main policy) – administrative efficiency and consolidated billing

---

**END OF SECTIONS 3 AND 4**

# RECORD OF ADVICE: POLICY AMENDMENT
## Motor Vehicle Addition – Personal Lines

---

## 5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED

### 5.1 Amendment Details

**Policy Number:** POL-2024-882  
**Amendment Type:** Addition of Motor Vehicle  
**Vehicle:** 2023 Toyota Corolla  
**Vehicle Identification Number:** [To be confirmed by client]  
**Agreed Sum Insured:** R320,000.00  
**Cover Type:** Comprehensive Motor Insurance (as per existing policy structure)

### 5.2 Sum Insured Schedule – Post Amendment

• **Existing Vehicle(s):** [Retain current sum insured and details as per original policy schedule]
• **New Vehicle Addition:** 2023 Toyota Corolla, Sum Insured R320,000.00
• **Total Aggregate Sum Insured:** [Updated total to be calculated by insurer]
• **Effective Date of Amendment:** [Date agreed with client and confirmed by underwriter]

### 5.3 Coverage Extended to New Vehicle

• Accidental loss or damage cover (Comprehensive basis)
• Third-party liability cover
• Medical expenses cover (where applicable under existing policy terms)
• Legal liability cover (as per original policy wording)
• All extensions and endorsements applying to the existing vehicle(s) shall extend to the new vehicle unless specifically excluded

### 5.4 Exclusions Applicable to New Vehicle

**Standard exclusions under Comprehensive Motor Cover:**

• Mechanical or electrical breakdown
• Wear and tear
• Damage resulting from lack of maintenance
• Use for racing, speed testing, or motor sport activities
• Driving by unlicensed, disqualified, or excluded drivers
• Claims arising whilst vehicle is used as a public conveyance for hire or reward (unless commercial cover endorsed)
• Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs
• Consequential loss or economic loss
• Damage to vehicle whilst left unlocked or keys left in vehicle (unless theft cover specifically applies)
• Unattended vehicle damage (except if vehicle is locked and keys removed)

### 5.5 Excess Structure – New Vehicle

• **Basic Excess:** R2,500.00 (standard for this vehicle age and value)
• **Voluntary Excess:** Client may elect to increase excess in exchange for reduced premium (options available on request)
• **Age-Related Excess:** Additional excess of R1,500.00 applies to drivers under 25 years of age, if applicable
• **Claims-Related Excess:** Additional excess of R2,000.00 applies to each claim if client has been involved in two or more claims within the preceding 36 months
• **Compulsory Excess:** No compulsory excess applies to theft cover (excess waived on theft claims)

### 5.6 SASRIA Cover – Riot, Strike, Civil Commotion and Terrorism

• **SASRIA Extension Available:** Specialist cover for loss or damage caused by acts of terrorism, rioting, strikes, civil commotion, malicious damage, and public disorder is available as an optional extension to the new vehicle
• **SASRIA Excess:** R10,000.00 (if SASRIA cover is elected)
• **Recommended Decision:** Given the vehicle value (R320,000) and current risk environment in South Africa, SASRIA cover is **strongly recommended** for comprehensive protection
• **Premium Implication:** SASRIA extension will result in additional monthly or annual premium; insurer quotation to be provided separately
• **Automatic Exclusion without SASRIA:** Without SASRIA extension, the policy will **exclude all losses arising from acts of terrorism, rioting, strike action, civil commotion, malicious damage by mob action, public disorder, or civil unrest**

### 5.7 Additional Terms Applicable to New Vehicle

• Vehicle must be roadworthy and compliant with National Road Traffic Act requirements
• Vehicle must be registered in client's name (or as stated in motor vehicle license disk)
• Vehicle security requirements as per existing policy (immobiliser, tracking device, or alarm system may be required depending on vehicle location and risk profile)
• Client must notify insurer immediately of any change in vehicle use, primary driver, or parking location

---

## 6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION

### 6.1 Broker Remuneration

**Financial Interest in Recommended Amendment:**

• Broker will receive standard commission of **[X]% of annual amendment premium** payable by the insurer upon acceptance and issuance of amended policy schedule
• Commission is earned on the additional premium attributable to the new vehicle only (not on existing policy premium)
• Remuneration structure is consistent across all three insurers considered in this advice

### 6.2 Conflict of Interest Assessment

**Identified Potential Conflicts:**

• Broker may benefit financially from recommending a higher sum insured (larger premium base = higher commission)
• Broker has commercial relationship with underwriting insurer that may influence product recommendation

**Conflict Mitigation Measures Applied:**

• Sum insinsured of R320,000 is based on agreed market value of vehicle and client's stated replacement cost requirement, not on premium optimization
• Needs analysis was conducted independently of commission consideration
• Client was explicitly advised that broker commission does not affect client's premium cost
• All insurer options (not only highest-commission option) were presented with equal professional consideration

### 6.3 No Tied Selling or Hidden Benefit

• This amendment is entirely voluntary and client-driven (client requested vehicle addition)
• No pressure or inducement has been applied to client to accept this amendment
• Broker has not received any incentive, bonus, or gift from the insurer contingent upon this transaction
• The recommended insurer was selected on merit based on coverage, claims service, and pricing – not on commission differential

### 6.4 Conflict of Interest Declaration – Client Acknowledgment

Client acknowledges receipt of this Conflict of Interest Declaration and confirms understanding that:

• Broker earns commission from the insurer on this amendment
• Commission does not increase the client's cost
• Client has the right to take independent advice
• Client may approach alternative brokers or insurers directly

---

## 7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE

### 7.1 Applicability Statement

**Not Applicable – This is a Policy Amendment, Not a Replacement**

• The amendment involves addition of a new vehicle to an existing personal lines motor policy (POL-2024-882)
• No existing insurance contract is being terminated or replaced
• Existing vehicles and their cover under POL-2024-882 remain in full force and effect
• Section 7 Replacement Advice requirements under FAIS Act do not apply to this transaction

### 7.2 Confirmation

• Client confirms that no existing motor insurance policy relating to the 2023 Toyota Corolla is being cancelled or replaced
• If client holds separate insurance on this vehicle with another insurer, that policy should be cancelled separately to avoid duplicate cover and double premium
• Broker has advised client to confirm cancellation instruction in writing to the alternative insurer once this amendment is accepted

---

## 8. CLIENT ACCEPTANCE RECORD

### 8.1 Client Confirmation of Understanding

I, the undersigned client, hereby confirm that:

• I have received a full and detailed Record of Advice regarding the amendment to policy POL-2024-882 for addition of the 2023 Toyota Corolla with a sum insured of R320,000.00

• I understand the coverage being provided, including the exclusions, excess structure, and optional SASRIA extension

• I have had the opportunity to ask questions and have received satisfactory answers from the broker

• I have not been pressurized to accept this amendment and understand that I may take independent advice if I wish

• I confirm that the needs analysis reflects my actual requirements and risk profile for this vehicle

• I acknowledge receipt of the Conflict of Interest Declaration and understand the broker's remuneration structure

• I accept the recommended insurer and product on the terms outlined in this Record of Advice

### 8.4 Retention and Distribution

• **Original RoA:** Retained by broker on file for 7 years (FAIS compliance requirement)
• **Client Copy:** Provided to client in writing (email or printed format) within 5 business days of this signature date
• **Insurer Copy:** Forwarded to underwriter with amendment request documentation
• **File Reference:** POL-2024-882 / Amendment RoA / [Date]

---

**This Record of Advice has been prepared in accordance with the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act 37 of 2002, Board Notice 80 of 2003, and General Notice 706 of 2020, and is suitable for FSCA inspection and audit purposes.**

---

*Prepared by Riya, FAIS Compliance Assistant | South African Short-Term Insurance Advice | Professional RoA Documentation*
